name: Citewise
description: Generate APA 7, MLA 9, Chicago 17 (author-date), and Harvard citations from a URL, DOI, or the current tab. Builds a persistent, re-formattable bibliography. Runs entirely client-side.
_comment_host_permissions: <all_urls> is required because the popup fetches arbitrary user-pasted URLs (to read their HTML <meta> tags) and queries the CrossRef API for DOIs. These fetches originate from the extension's own popup context and must bypass the target pages' CORS headers, which is only possible with host_permissions. No content is ever sent to a server other than CrossRef; everything else is processed locally.
